issue.title: Docs: Refresh recordings-sync-contract.md for fluent-api main (verse-audio + R2)
issue.body:
## Summary

`docs/guides/recordings-sync-contract.md` still describes fluent-api `main` as having **no** verse-audio routes and freezes the contract against open PR #224 / Azure Blob. That is stale.

Verified against local fluent-api checkout on `main` (`0ebc096`): `src/domains/verse-audio/` is present; `PUT/GET/DELETE /verse-audio/...` are registered; storage is Cloudflare R2 via `src/lib/audio-storage.ts`, with **503** `"Audio storage is unavailable"` when R2 is unset or the bucket probe failed.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Update the “fluent-api truth” table to current `main` (verse-audio shipped; R2, not Azure).
- [ ] Document 503 storage-unavailable behavior and that mobile treats 503 as terminal failed (`verseAudioContract.ts`).
- [ ] Remove or clearly mark obsolete Azure / PR #224 “open” wording; keep mobile↔API path/auth contract accurate.
- [ ] Cross-link from `docs/AGENT_ONBOARDING.md` / recordings docs index if needed so agents stop citing the stale table.

## Out of scope

- App code changes for Sync Now / upload UI.
- Provisioning R2 in any deployed environment.

## Related

- `docs/guides/recordings-sync-contract.md`
- fluent-api: `src/domains/verse-audio/verse-audio.route.ts`, `src/lib/audio-storage.ts`
- Mobile: `src/services/verseAudioContract.ts`
